items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] When Mary McBrothen was doing some things with the school kids in Washington... [INTERVIEWEE] I know.

ctx.x: I can talk better on wine.

Because -- the school -- that leads into something else. When Mary McBrothen was doing some things with the school kids in Washington, and there the school population is about 97 percent black. And she got Duke to read and come and talk to them and play for them, and she said most of them didn't know who he was.
